definitions.explanation: A number written as a whole number with a proper fraction beside it, such as 1 and 2/3. Japanese textbooks introduce it as the readable way of expressing a {仮分数|かぶんすう} (improper fraction).

examples.japanese: ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{帯分数|たいぶんすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Write the answer as a mixed number.

examples.japanese: {帯分数|たいぶんすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: It's easier to grasp the size when it's written as a mixed number.

examples.japanese: {帯分数|たいぶんすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{整数|せいすう}→整数：04328_seisuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{真分数|しんぶんすう}→真分数：30691_shinbunsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧しやすい。
examples.english: Mixed numbers are easier to calculate with if you think of them as a whole-number part and a proper-fraction part.

notes:
⟦{帯|たい}→〜帯：30366_tai⟧ (to wear, to carry alongside) + ⟦{分数|ぶんすう}→分数：06952_bunsuu⟧ (fraction): a fraction carrying a whole number with it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帯分数|たいぶんすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|なお}す: to convert into a mixed number
- {帯分数|たいぶんすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express as a mixed number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仮分数|かぶんすう}→仮分数：30692_kabunsuu⟧: improper fraction — the same value written with a single numerator and denominator
- ⟦{真分数|しんぶんすう}→真分数：30691_shinbunsuu⟧: proper fraction — the fractional part of a mixed number
- ⟦{整数|せいすう}→整数：04328_seisuu⟧: whole number, integer — the part written to the left
